steps.what: emulsifying salts, then cream or butter
steps.note: The fresh curd is melted into a smooth mass by the salts.
The mass is cooked, stirred, until it is molten and smooth.
The hot mass is filled into plastic or glass jars.

links.name: Journal of Food Science 77(8) 2012: Effect of the type of emulsifying salt on "requeijão cremoso" (da Cunha, Alcântara, Viotto)

sources.text: The introduction describes how requeijão cremoso is made from fresh curd: fusion with emulsifying salts, cream or butter, cooking at 85-95 °C for 2-7 min and hot filling. Other processed cheeses from fresh curd (cancoillotte) are not covered.
